name: game-sfx-pack
description: Make a game's sound effects from its event list: jump, coin, hit, explosion, button click and more are synthesised procedurally (reproducible, with variations you can re-roll and tweak), existing recordings are trimmed, loudness-matched and turned into seamless loops, and everything is exported by category as WAV/OGG with a manifest. Runs locally; no API keys.

description_i18n.en: Make a game's sound effects from its event list: jump, coin, hit, explosion, button click and more are synthesised procedurally (reproducible, with variations you can re-roll and tweak), existing recordings are trimmed, loudness-matched and turned into seamless loops, and everything is exported by category as WAV/OGG with a manifest. Runs locally; no API keys.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 按游戏事件清单制作音效：跳跃、金币、受击、爆炸、按钮点击等用程序合成（可复现，可换变体、可微调），已有录音可以去首尾静音、统一响度、做成无缝循环，最后按分类导出 WAV/OGG 和清单。在本地运行，无需 API 密钥。

ffmpegPath.title: ffmpeg 路径（可选）
ffmpegPath.description: 可选。只有导入 MP3/OGG 等非 WAV 声音或导出 OGG 时需要 ffmpeg。默认在 PATH 和 /opt/homebrew/bin、/usr/local/bin 中查找。
